items.note: S1.2 states the eight-row schedule, the three stages and (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch, and S1.2.1-S1.2.4 follow the proof at 741-765: the net change (JV+RG)x, the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2, and the composition of three stages. The neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783) and the sizes h=100, N, m=h^3 are never given, but they are not part of the lemma.

The steps reproduce the invariant (stored array = D_v applied to the logical array, with g = D_in^{-1} f), the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, all as in the paper.

The form, terminal labels, stage transitions, side-wire inclusion, the single decreasing edge (center 3->4, loss h), telescoping, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, the orthonormal bases over F_2 and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are all present. Digit permutation by q^2 streams, digit move by q streams, cyclic row dealing into W streams of volume V/W, counter costs, the split-and-swap rotation for controlled shifts, absorption of b^{O(1)} offset work, multiplication by a unit via c pieces, and negation all match the two proofs.

The lower-lower factorization by elimination from the topmost nonzero row, the triangular updates in descending order with a prime avoiding denominators, and the update-swap-update realising each one of Pi with exactly one interchange follow 1375-1447.

Row dealing into W role streams, edge shears Phi_{A_e} by recursive interchanges, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, exactly s calls on volume V/W, the recurrence and its unrolling, the depth-first parking schedule and the descriptor bound are all in the paper's order.

The high-digit row field with R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, the base-m split into power-width pieces with cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), binary padding to [q^e], and the one-bit width difference all follow the proof.

Basic identities, the edge frame change as a product of rho_edge kernels, conjugation by P_M, one child per slot, (C^{-1})^{(x)f}=(-i)^f Z C^{(x)f} Z, elimination into row additions, s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D all match 1835-1940.

errors.says: Implementing each edge change by smaller calls with s<Wm and s/W<m^tau gives cost per volume O(e^tau) at parameter e, both for the bit network (address interchange) and for the complex network (butterfly layers).
errors.paper: Only the bit recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) gives O(e^tau) (1550-1557). The complex recurrence has node overhead O((eK)^tau+1) and leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, and its result is O(d^{lambda'}) with max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1 (2406-2445), not O(e^tau).

errors.says: Method: choose labels so that gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size and the only decreasing edges are the central-wire returns.
errors.paper: The intersection-dependent coefficients belong to the scalar network (689-703, 752-758). The labels are chosen so that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal (869-870, 953) and decreases are confined to the central return (954-958).

errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero residual contains a norm-one coordinate unit (so it is nonalternating).
errors.paper: A norm-one vector in each nonzero tensor summand is formed as a tensor of chosen norm-one vectors (coordinate units, or the triple vectors spanning P and Q). It need not be a coordinate unit of the residual (1075-1085).

errors.says: The deficit is 2N-2L_c>0; here no extra source ranks are needed, so the deficit is larger than in the bit network.
errors.paper: The paper states only the deficit 2N-2L_c>0 (1260). The comparison holds for absolute deficits, but the relative deficit that fixes the exponent is smaller for the complex network: eta_c=73/19906842167500 < eta_b=339/22587335000000 (1319-1324).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish. It runs from the scalar bank exchange, frames and subspace labels to the rank budget s<Wm and tau=1-2^{-50}, then to the interchange and layer recurrences, the synthetic transforms and convolution, Gaussian resampling with the chirp and permutation cancellation, the six-step algorithm, exact recovery, and the time table with kappa=2^{-182}. It thins out at the labels, where S1.4.1.5 asserts comparability without the gate-label table or the residual table. The sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never defined, and the umbrella step S1.4 overstates the complex network's cost as O(e^tau). The disproof of the conjecture is not drawn.

steps.note: The fixed linear network (eight rows, copy, gather, scatter and side injection, three stages) taking (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restoring all scratch values is carried in full. The sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3, and the indexing of the banks by triples, are missing; this is a borderline credit for the mechanism.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge pays only D_vD_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{(x)3} built from triple indicators, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decrease being the central 3->4 edge losing h are stated. The label dimension m is left implicit, and the per-time gate labels are not given.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
Telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b are all stated.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_bm.
The endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m and I_m on every other role, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, each realised by one interchange, plus O(V); the node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present.

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed, in the paper's order and roles. The plan runs from the bank-exchange network through frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L with its N source exceptions, the strict deficit from L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weak points are the network's sizes (h=100, N, m=h^3 are never defined) and the gate-label assignment, which is asserted rather than shown.
